reply_text: Sofia, I replied in #coastal-team: Pellucid Harbor Logistics belongs to Kwame Adjei-Rowe, who took it over from Bettina on November 22, 2025. Bettina confirmed on October 14 that it stays with Kwame, so the PHL ticket should go to him. I also noted that if the ticket is for Pellow, Bettina is covering that account next week.
